nodes.title: Audit platform (PLAT-57/58/59): removed code nothing reads; every removed path is still in commit c3977509
Rejected: dropping the calendar table (PLAT-56 listed it as unused). server/conductor/view.js reads it for the Conductor's day kinds; migration 050 drops the other five only

md.decisions:
## r7-audit-platform-deletions
**Removed (last held in c3977509):** scripts/offkit-cards.mjs, scripts/reveals-unit-sweep.mjs, scripts/self-answer-sweep.mjs (no importer, package script, workflow, Dockerfile, test or doc); server/auth.js verifyPassword (no importer; hashPassword stays, evals and tests use it); server/azure.js DEPLOY.stagecraftSpec (read nowhere; only old patches under docs/ name it); shared/trace.ts TraceSrc, TraceBlobResponse, TraceMe (no importer); src/trace/bus.ts setTurn and src/trace/flag.ts flagStats (no caller); the second registration of the placement routes in server/index.js (server/routes/child.js already registers them). **Kept on purpose:** shared/trace.ts TRACE_KINDS and TraceKind (the documented kind list the writer's JSDoc points to); server/lanes.js twinFor and server/endpoints.js laneHost/laneHosts (tests read them); scripts/handoff/blob.py and redact.py (docs/handoff/STORAGE.md says they built the archives); scripts/r4-session-env.mjs (context/architecture.md cites it); scripts/region/staging.mjs (docs/ops/INDIA-MOVE.md tells the reader to run it). **Left to their owners:** server/duplex/routes.js (voice), server/routes/modules.js (games), POST /api/forge/requests, POST /api/forge/prefetch and GET /api/studio/health (studio).
md.rejected:
## r7-audit-platform-calendar-kept
The platform audit listed calendar among six tables nothing reads. The migration test that checks every dropped table against server/ and scripts/ SQL found server/conductor/view.js:108 reading it (the Conductor's day-kind lookup). Migration 050 drops module_run, rate_bucket, kt_params, voicesig.calibration and voicesig.population_norm only. Reversal: if the Conductor stops reading calendar, drop it in a later migration.
